facts.fact: ACTPOL says the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 created an independent Nigeria Data Protection Commission, which it describes as an active regulator running registration, audit and investigations.
ACTPOL reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission was reported to have fined MultiChoice Nigeria N766,242,500 in July 2025, in part for unlawful cross-border transfers.
ACTPOL cites a January 2026 statement that the Commission's 246 concluded investigations had produced 11 enforcement actions.
